cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
cards.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle the wedding calls. Your date is still safe; the venue needs a little rearranging.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please tell me we still have the hall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We have the garden. I can move the chairs outside, but the hall won't open.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Stop planning around me. Is it repairs, or has something happened?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There was a fire. I'll stop making calls; tell me when you want to look at other places.

reason: Replace A3 disclosure rationale with a concrete garden proposal; A5 now answers B cause question and yields the planning control actually challenged.
